q1_issues.issue: "The four sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd" is a counted definite plural with a non-collective predicate, so the per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x sk_skycats_1) is due alongside the group event, but only the group event is emitted.

"The nightmoths left silken threads on the lanterns" likewise gets a group event with no per-member distribution rule, although leaving threads is distributive and every other plural-subject predicate in the parse (burn, show, descend, survive, flee, reach, molt) does get one.
"the East Row" is treated as a multi-word name but the kind word inside the name yields no type atom — the Kestrel-River rule directs that (Member east_row row) be stated beside the Name atom.

q2_gaps: An in-world calendar date ("on day 630 of Year 2"): the structured Time terms (Day n)/(Year n) are specified for Gregorian dates, and a day-of-year number far above 31 plus a bare regnal year are not addressed.

An anaphoric definite mass NP whose antecedent was encoded as a bare kind filler ("the lanterns produced mist-light" ... "The mist-light attracted nightmoths"): the bare-class rule gives the non-specific object the constant mist_light while the later definite mints sk_mistlight_1, and no rule links the two, so the passage's causal chain is severed.

An agent-nominalization's of-phrase ("the keepers of the East Row"): the nominalization test ("the N of X" ~ "what Vs X" -> the surface-preposition oblique (Of ...)) and the true-relational-noun/role carve-out (-> Possession) both fit a -er noun with a live underlying verb, and nothing selects between them.
notes: The collective/distributive split is otherwise handled exactly as specified — bare "together" suppresses the rule for lit and produced, and gather and shrink stay group-only — which makes the two missing rules read as omissions rather than collective readings. "the Hollows" is correctly Name-only with no type atom and no GroupOf, and the During link on the molting and the LocatedIn on the nightmoth crowd both follow the instruction set.
